dedupe_keys.name: danish road directorate road weather feeds road weather stations and municipal road condition reports

description: The Danish Road Directorate publishes two road weather feeds through its data exchange portal (Dataudveksleren). The Road Weather Station Information feed gives readings from roadside road weather information stations across Denmark: road surface temperature, air temperature at 2 m, dew point, humidity and, at some stations such as bridges, 10-minute mean wind speed and direction; most stations measure temperature only. The Road Weather Condition Report feed gives, for state roads and every municipality, the reported road and cycle path conditions and winter service level per road class, updated when conditions change, and is the information behind slipperiness and snow clearing icons on vintertrafik.dk. Both are XML feeds listed in the Danish data catalogue and on data.europa.eu, the station feed under CC BY 4.0 and the condition report under CC BY-NC 4.0, free of charge. Caveats: the portal pages need JavaScript and could not be read here, so the feed format and registration steps were taken from the catalogue entries; municipal condition reports carry a random point per municipality, not road geometry; and the non-commercial licence limits reuse of the condition feed. The feeds support hazard exposure and operations studies of roads in snow and ice, such as calibrating winter maintenance or slipperiness models; related records are the Netherlands national road network and the Sweden NJDB railway network.
